Input images are identity/style references: preserve the EXACT mint green furry character, cream belly and huge cream inner ears, dark brown outlines, coral cheek blush, plant terrarium backpack. Match the first reference's full-body view, proportions and paw placement closely. Output a square canvas with EXACTLY FOUR equally sized square cells, aligned as a 2x2 grid. No cell borders or labels, NO TEXT. Real transparent alpha across all empty areas, no checkerboard or background. TOP LEFT: eyes open, both EMPTY paws just below muzzle, mouth visibly open to receive a bite. TOP RIGHT: content eyes gently closed, mouth closed puckered toward right, LEFT cheek rounded and puffed to show chewing. BOTTOM LEFT: same pose, mouth closed puckered toward left, RIGHT cheek rounded and puffed to show the alternating chew; ears slightly relaxed. BOTTOM RIGHT: swallowing finished, both paws lowered a little, satisfied gentle smile and closed crescent eyes, slight happy head tilt. The changes must be clearly legible as a chewing animation at small UI sizes, yet maintain tight frame-to-frame alignment. No food, no cup, no plate, no extra objects or characters. Soft hand-painted storybook illustration consistent with reference, NOT 3D. Intended for CSS background-position animation; preserve a crisp four-cell grid.
